training.read: Stable optimization; basis regression trained cleanly, token accuracy stayed low but nonzero.

mechanism_read: The continuous low-frequency scaffold is a real new mechanism class. It preserves daily change law and cross-cell structure while materially improving level-law fit, but the current basis scaffold is too smooth and too weakly mean-reverting, leading to under-reversion and worse worst-cell cointegration robustness.
decision: Keep the 294 continuous scaffold family alive for one narrow follow-up. Next step: post-experiment analysis / ideation for 294b to sharpen the scaffold without returning to support codebooks.
